profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer as Cars Commerce
profile.summary:
Building software is a pastime to me.  I like everything about it.  

The very best part about technology is the fact that it is an ever changing landscape.  For those of us who enjoy the pastime, we are constantly resurveying the lay of the land to see the current state of things. 
Learning, tinkering, trying, failing, growing....  

Currently much of my development time is spent with the android platform, Kotlin, and coroutines, but I also enjoy building with iOS/Swift,  C/C++, Go, Node.js, Rust, .NET core, docker, bash, awk, ... and countless other things.

My skill set also encompasses application security, cryptography, relational and no-SQL databases, cross platform applications, and an occasional LIMS

So much out there, why limit yourself?
